_notes: THE DROPLET ATLAS -- eight stills, one per cell, in the sources' README order:
round drop, stretched drop, heavy drop, curved streak, reverse curved streak,
torn sheet, forked sheet, splash fork. NOT a sequence: the emitter picks one per
particle by hash, so the folder is a palette and the order only decides which
EXPLICIT RECTS, and here the argument is sharper than for the contact sheet.
Same 1774x887 4x2 delivery, same 444/443 alternation, same two-pixel drift by the
fourth column -- but a contact cell is padded onto 512 and played as one frame of
a burst, while each of these cells becomes a SPRITE drawn a few dozen pixels
wide. A sliver of the neighbouring drop sliced into a cell is a second droplet in
the frame at that size. Measured on this sheet: r0c0's content reaches x=444 and
r0c1's starts at x=0, so the round drop and the stretched drop touch across the
seam the floor grid would cut through. The rects are the README's own column and
NO CANVAS STATED: the rects give 444x444 and 443x443 cells and nothing here
scales, so the automatic pad onto the largest (444x444) is all that is needed.
Centred and transparent-padded, so no drop is resized.
Delivered with its own alpha; keyed is false, like the rest of the pack.
